blurb: East West Helicopter Inc provides helicopter maintenance, repairs, modifications, and sales. It is part of EPICENTER Aviation, which offers comprehensive aircraft support and services including mechanical, composite, structural sheet metal repair, limited overhaul, avionics design, installation, and integration. The facility includes a private airport with FBO services, hangars, and fuel.
